**Chinese name:** 上海天数智芯半导体股份有限公司 (Tiānshù Zhìxīn)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's first company to mass-produce a general-purpose training GPU (天垓100, 2021) and, with H1 2026 results (revenue ¥9.46亿 +191.6%, net +¥1.06亿), the first of the GPU startups to post a profitable half-year — the unit-economics proof point for the whole sector. FY2025 revenue ¥10.34亿 (+91.6%).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Cloud training/inference GPGPU chips and cards, edge AI products, AI servers/cluster solutions.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2015 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | General GPGPUs: 天垓 training series (100/150/Gen3, Gen4 announced July 2026), 智铠 inference series, 彤央 edge modules |
| **Node Sophistication** | Gen2-class ~7/12nm-equivalent (undisclosed); HBM-equipped; domestic-node transition implied by 60%-of-placement supply-chain mandate — specifics not verified |
| **Entity List** | No |
